claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.fixed_save_dc
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item spell grants currently record only spell id and casting mode. Wind Fan casts Gust of Wind at a fixed item DC 13, which materially changes spell resolution and cannot be omitted honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this fan, you can cast Gust of Wind (save DC 13) from it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: cumulative_pre_dawn_failure_policy
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item does not use charges or a fixed use count. Instead, each reuse before dawn increases a cumulative failure chance, and failure destroys the item. Existing ActivationResource and ItemDestructionPolicy variants cannot represent that escalating stateful risk honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each subsequent time the fan is used before the next dawn, it has a cumulative 20 percent chance of not working; if the fan fails to work, it tears into useless, nonmagical tatters.
